name: crr-cql-tooling
description: Translate CRR criteria CQL to ELM (@cqframework/cql, pure JS) and run scenario tests (cql-execution).

scripts.build: node translate.mjs libraries/FHIRHelpers-4.0.1.cql ../elm/FHIRHelpers-4.0.1.json && node translate.mjs ../cql/CRR_CTChestAbdomenPelvis_Adult.cql ../elm/CRR_CTChestAbdomenPelvis_Adult.json && node translate.mjs ../cql/CRR_CTCAP_Population.cql ../elm/CRR_CTCAP_Population.json && node translate.mjs ../cql/CRR_RedFlags.cql ../elm/CRR_RedFlags.json && node translate.mjs ../sites/ct-colonography-adult/CRR_CTColonography_Adult.cql ../elm/CRR_CTColonography_Adult.json && node translate.mjs ../sites/ct-chest-adult/CRR_CTChest_Adult.cql ../elm/CRR_CTChest_Adult.json && node translate.mjs ../sites/ct-head-adult/CRR_CTHead_Adult.cql ../elm/CRR_CTHead_Adult.json && node translate.mjs ../sites/us-abdomen-adult/CRR_USAbdomen_Adult.cql ../elm/CRR_USAbdomen_Adult.json && node translate.mjs ../sites/us-dvt-adult/CRR_USDVT_Adult.cql ../elm/CRR_USDVT_Adult.json && node translate.mjs ../sites/us-pelvis-adult/CRR_USPelvis_Adult.cql ../elm/CRR_USPelvis_Adult.json && node translate.mjs ../sites/us-renal-adult/CRR_USRenal_Adult.cql ../elm/CRR_USRenal_Adult.json && node translate.mjs ../sites/xray-chest-adult/CRR_XRChest_Adult.cql ../elm/CRR_XRChest_Adult.json
scripts.test: node run-tests.mjs && node run-tests-redflags.mjs && node run-tests-sites.mjs && node test-cross-bundle-include.mjs && node test-errata-check.mjs && node run-ground-truth.mjs
